intent: Introduce colour with intent into a surface that is flat or monochrome.
moves: Assign the accent one job on the surface and give it to nothing else.
Carry status in colour plus a word or shape, so it survives colourblindness and greyscale.
Tint neutrals toward the accent hue rather than adding a second colour.
Use the darkest and lightest ramp steps for text and ground, and the middle for the accent.
Check every new pair against the contrast floor before committing it.
avoid: A second accent colour, which halves the meaning of the first.
Colour as the only difference between two states.
Pure grey neutrals next to a warm or cool accent — they read as dirty.
